name: 28강. 배포하기 | 리액트 입문 — 컴포넌트로 만드는 웹
summary: Free Korean lesson 28 of a React intro course: deployment plus component libraries (shadcn/ui, Radix UI) and accessibility basics.
description: Lesson 28 of the free 30-part Korean course 'React intro — building the web with components', readable without an account. It covers deployment and walks through why to use a component library, how shadcn/ui and Radix UI handle accessibility, and the cn() Tailwind class-merge utility.
